manualFollowUps: After separately authorized PR/CI release, run supabase db push --linked against the verified production project.
Run supabase functions deploy guide --project-ref <verified-production-ref>; confirm the guide gateway configuration from supabase/config.toml.
Verify the guide-retention cleanup schedule or install the service-role cleanup job before publishing.
Keep entry disabled until an authorized admin has reviewed translations, audio, real catalog mappings and privacy copy, validated, then published the first version.
verification: Run npm run test:guide, npm run check:guide, npm run test:guide:browser and npm run verify:prod.
Verify authorized guest-to-result, account claim, owned access, confirmed goal transfer and separately authorized payment journeys on production before publishing.
Confirm version rollback, private-table RLS, answer-key projection and seven-day retention.
Confirm page-loaded receipts, confirmed paid attribution and honest no-match fallback; do not treat page loads as learning activation.

rollback.frontends: Disable entry in Admin Onboarding, or restore a validated earlier guide version. If code rollback is needed, use tracked Cloudflare Pages rollback to the previous known-good commit; never local Pages deploy.
rollback.edgeFunctions: Keep guide_release disabled and redeploy the prior reviewed guide function through the authorized operations workflow. Existing products do not depend on this function.
rollback.database: Leave additive private tables intact. Do not drop retained session or payment data as a frontend rollback.
